one_liner: The offer appears inside the Teacher chat, right under Luzia's last reply.
author: aadi

change.what_is_different_here: The Luzia+ paywall (s02) lists 'Advanced reasoning mode' (s02.e03) as a paid feature, and Chats carries a Luzia+ badge (s01.e02). A returning free user sees a one-day, 3-answer sample of it inside the Teacher chat (s07), right under Luzia's last reply. The full feature stays behind the Weekly / Monthly / Annual plans and the 3-day trial (s02.e19).
change.trigger_event: A user without Luzia+ opens the Teacher chat for the first time after 3 or more days with no session.
change.placement: Inside the Teacher chat, right under Luzia's last reply.
change.frequency_cap: 1 per day, resets at midnight local time; shown only in the first Teacher chat after a 3+ day gap
change.decline_path: Tapping 'Not now' closes the card. The chat works exactly as before, and the card does not return until the user's next gap of 3+ days.

flow_steps.caption: A user who hasn't opened Luzia in 3+ days opens the Teacher chat.
Right under Luzia's last reply, a welcome-back card offers 3 answers in Advanced reasoning mode for a short game.
The user plays a short sponsored game and can close it at any time.
The card in the chat changes to '3 Advanced reasoning answers ready today. Ask away.'

change.after_reward: When the 3 answers are used or the day ends, a small note in the chat says Luzia+ keeps Advanced reasoning mode on every day and shows the 3-day free trial button. The user has just felt what they would be paying for.
